sprints.title: CodeWiki vNext decision and graph workflow
sprints.outcome: Deliver the vNext operating model in bounded compatibility-safe increments, now prioritizing agent-owned session-boundary automation and workflow-efficiency friction reduction before decision_build implementation.
gates: Prioritize TASK-005 session-boundary automation/workflow-friction work before TASK-001 decision_build implementation until this accepted priority is resolved.
Keep current CodeWiki public behavior frozen except critical blocker fixes until vNext replacement flows validate.
Do not remove compatibility feedback/documentation/build/tool primitives before deprecation tests pass.
Each task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.

sprints.title: Decision propagation and file-structure follow-through
sprints.outcome: Prevent accepted decisions from drifting by enforcing decision-to-roadmap propagation and by giving the file-structure decision durable follow-up work.
gates: TASK-011 must land before future planning builds can be trusted to enforce complete decision propagation.
TASK-013 and TASK-014 preserve the accepted file-structure decision as durable follow-up work; they may be reprioritized after TASK-011 but must not disappear into open questions.
Each implementation task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.

sprints.title: Complete concept-root source migration

gates: Each task must compile an implementation_build before validation.
Each task must pass implementation validation before task close.
Final API/shared cleanup must prove no unapproved src/domain/** or src/application/** owner paths remain.
